SELECT  
    T1.ORDER_PACK_NUM AS ORDER_MONTH,
    T1.VIN_BRAND_CD,
    T5.REGION_CD,
    T1.MODEL_YEAR,
    T1.OSR_STATUS_CD,
    T1.INVENTORY_DEALER_CD,
    T5.DEALER_NAME,
    T5.ADI_DESC,
    T2.SERIES_DESC,
    T2.MODEL_GROUP_DESC AS MODEL_GROUP,
    T2.TRIM_DESC,
    T2.DRIVETRAIN_DESC,
    T2.ENGINE_DESC,
    T3.PACKAGE_DESC,
    T1.WHOLESALE_SALES_MONTH_KEY,
    T1.RDR_SALES_MONTH_KEY,
    T1.DELIVERY_COMPLETION_DATE,
    T4.PRODUCTION_DATE,
    T1.PORT_ARRIVAL_DATE,
    T1.GROUP_DATE,
    T1.SHIPMENT_OUT_DATE,
    T1.RDR_DATE,
    T1.WHOLESALE_DATE,
    COUNT(T1.VEHICLE_KEY) AS QUANTITY
FROM
    HMA_DM_SALES.QM_VH_VEHICLE_SAP T1,
    HMA_DM_SALES.QM_TD_MODEL T2,
    HMA_DM_SALES.QM_TD_VEHICLE_MATERIAL T3,
    HMA_DM_SALES.QM_TH_VEHICLE_STATUS T4,
    HMA_DM_SALES.QM_TD_DEALER T5  
WHERE
    T1.MODEL_KEY = T2.MODEL_KEY AND
    T1.VEHICLE_MATERIAL_KEY = T3.VEHICLE_MATERIAL_KEY AND
    T1.VEHICLE_KEY = T4.VEHICLE_KEY AND
    T4.INVENTORY_DEALER_KEY = T5.DEALER_KEY AND
    T1.ORDER_PACK_NUM >= to_number(to_char(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-21), 'YYYYMM'))
GROUP BY
    T1.ORDER_PACK_NUM,
    T1.VIN_BRAND_CD,
    T5.REGION_CD,
    T1.MODEL_YEAR,
    T1.OSR_STATUS_CD,
    T1.INVENTORY_DEALER_CD,
    T5.DEALER_NAME,
    T5.ADI_DESC,
    T2.SERIES_DESC,
    T2.MODEL_GROUP_DESC,
    T2.TRIM_DESC,
    T2.DRIVETRAIN_DESC,
    T2.ENGINE_DESC,
    T3.PACKAGE_DESC,
    T1.WHOLESALE_SALES_MONTH_KEY,
    T1.RDR_SALES_MONTH_KEY,
    T1.DELIVERY_COMPLETION_DATE,
    T4.PRODUCTION_DATE,
    T1.PORT_ARRIVAL_DATE,
    T1.GROUP_DATE,
    T1.SHIPMENT_OUT_DATE,
    T1.RDR_DATE,
    T1.WHOLESALE_DATE
